Softmax vs. Sigmoid: when and why? (3 pts) Softmax — multi-class classification (e.g., classifying an image as cat/dog/bird): Sigmoid — multi-label classification (e.g., tagging a movie as action/comedy/romance): Aspect Softmax Sigmoid Output constraint ∑i pi = 1 Each pi ∈ (0, 1) independently Loss function Categorical cross-entropy Binary cross-entropy per label ∇bf = ∂f ∂r ⋅ ∂r ∂b = r ⋅ 1 ∇bf = Ax + b − t ∇Af = (Ax + b − t)x⊤ Classes are mutually exclusive; softmax outputs sum to 1 Sigmoid would allow high probability for multiple classes, violating exclusivity Labels are independent; a movie can have multiple genres Softmax would force probabilities to sum to 1, incorrectly constraining predictions
